tables.caption: The inhibitory efficiency of eight synthetic CDPs (15 mM) against C. violaceum CV026 and P. aeruginosa PAO1 in M63 medium. Different letters indicate statistical significance between groups by Tukey’s HSD test at p < 0.05.
footnotes: Note: This table uses the letters a and b to show statistically significant differences between inhibitory ratios in mean comparisons. If there are no significant differences between two inhibitory ratios, they get the same letter (a:a or b:b). If there are significant differences between two inhibitory ratios, they get the different letters (a:b).
